[color=#E07A2E][bold]RUSTBUCKET BBS[/bold][/color]
[color=#E8D45A]est. on a spare cargo terminal, still running on its original battery[/color]
Old timers' board. It started as a swap list for spare parts between the mine shifts and the hauler crews, and it never really stopped. These days people trade more than parts here.
Be polite, keep it short, and do not ask who set it up.
